title: Price's Drugstore as a hangout
summary: Collette and Howard recall the drugstore on Central as a hangout, where Collette saw Jack Johnson.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: What about the -- do you remember the Drugstore? See, some of these things I remember, too.
The Drugstore? Oh, yeah, I'd go in there all the time, sure.
Yeah, that was a hangout, wasn't it?
Yeah, a hangout. Very nice. They had people going in the drugstore. Price's Drugstore, Price.
I saw Jack Johnson -- prizefighter. (Inaudible.) Did you ever see him? He used to hang out there.
Oh, yeah, but he never hung out there.
I used to see him every night in it.
Did you? In the nighttime? Well, I don't know.
When we got in the business - we were hanging out late and you were probably home in bed. (Inaudible)
